written_before: any real-geometry SRK certification (the only runs before this file: synthetic h=3 profiling at E=[1/2, 1/2+1/32], exact FSM fixtures)
purpose: fix, target-free, every decoy on which SRK is validated, so that no decoy can be chosen to imitate the quarantined regime

real_geometry.rule: block width 1/32 at the five declared left endpoints, all < 6/5 (below the band, so that no pair of decoys brackets it; overnight amendment 2 R2.1 rationale). No drift >= 6/5 is ever used for the real kernel in this campaign.

latent_proxy_class: Every SRK decoy output (Gamma, Abar_W, ratios) is a LATENT PROXY in the sense of overnight amendment 2 R2.3. It is never juxtaposed, combined or compared with any 305-309 number, and it is reported in handovers by content class plus dimensionless decoy-only ratios.
no_selection: All declared decoys are run and reported. None is dropped or added after results.
